newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary Postabank revises '96 profit down - report.
newsitem.headline: Hungary Postabank revises '96 profit down - report.

text.p: Figures published by Hungary's second largest commercial bank Postabank on Monday showed 5.6 million forints after-tax profit for 1996, the Hungarian economic news agency MTI-Econews said.
MTI-Econews said the after-tax profit seemed to have been sharply reduced compared with a pre-tax profit figure of 3.165 billion forints published by the bank in a preliminary report on February 14.
Postabank was hit by a panic withdrawal of deposits of about 24 billion forints at the end of February.

According to the new figures, Postabank's 1996 balance sheet total amounted to 379 billion forints at the end of 1996, down by nine billion forints compared with the preliminary figures, MTI-Econews said.

It added that Postabank's risk provisions totalled 14.15 billion forints in 1996, but the figure would be 12 billion forint higher if the government had not granted a guarantee of 12 billion forints to Postabank last week.
MTI-Econews said that the report published on Monday did not make clear if the figures were audited or non-audited.
Postabank officials were not immediately available to comment.
